cohort.filter: accepted hardware mapping, release date precedes observed benchmark date, non-null target

protocol.preprocessing: fit per fold: numeric median plus missing indicator; categorical __MISSING__
protocol.target_leakage_policy: Only configuration/workload fields and Epoch physical descriptors are features; no InferenceX outcome, Epoch composite score, or visualization coordinate is a feature.
protocol.temporal_status: Post-hoc descriptor study. It is not an as-of historical prediction claim because the available Epoch snapshot is newer than the InferenceX snapshot.
protocol.uncertainty: Not evaluated; no prior conformal interval is reused.
